_contract: Explicit aggregate-PR classification for the Prism UI lane-state snapshot. An aggregate PR composes other PRs' contributions (an integration/evidence baseline) and therefore touches paths owned by several lanes without taking ownership of any of them. Declared here as data so the classifier never infers it from a title substring or a branch prefix -- either would silently strip a genuine multi-lane implementation PR from lane ownership. Read by scripts/lane_state_refresh.py; a malformed file aborts the refresh (exit 2) rather than falling back to 'nothing is aggregate'.

aggregate_prs.reason: EWOR evidence baseline composing #663-#667. Its diff spans all four lanes' owned paths because it carries their contributions, not because it owns those lanes. Excluded from lane ownership and active-thread selection; retained in aggregate_prs for audit.
